outcome: A parent can take over the same live game from a child on the retained stream, and any fail-closed rejection leaves the original child stream observable and dismissible instead of trapping an opaque Ready overlay.
production_path: Android recognizes the same host, execution profile, stream target and provider game as a retained actor handoff
The retained Game owner obtains an exact provider process identity from the existing observer or an authenticated Gateway snapshot before changing the child time attachment
Gateway reauthorizes the exact stream, app, game, process and control generation for the parent actor
Android atomically commits and publishes the new actor binding without restarting transport
The existing transition controller reveals only after the correlated post-handoff frame
If identity or authorization cannot be proved, Android restores a valid observation of the still-owned child stream or closes fail-closed after an attachment-changing ambiguity
artifact_compatibility_matrix: deployed Android + current Gateway: reported parent takeover failure and stuck Ready overlay remain
corrected Android + older Gateway without fenced reauthorization: remains fail-closed
Gateway-only update: cannot fix the client-side pre-authorization identity gap
architecture_boundary: Reuse SessionOrchestrator, RetainedStreamSessionCoordinator, RetainedControlHandoff, PlayniteTransitionGateway and LaunchTransitionController. Do not add a profile-specific stream lifecycle, bypass process identity, force-dismiss privacy, or restart transport.
required_checks: failing-before Android regression for same-game child-to-parent takeover when the observer has no cached process identity
regression proving the exact authenticated Gateway snapshot can supply the missing process token and PID before child release
negative regressions for mismatched game, missing token, missing PID, stale generation and changed retained owner
regression proving pre-authorization failure does not strand an opaque overlay or close the existing observer
targeted retained stream, transition, profile switch and S05 contract tests
full NonRoot Android unit suite and debug/release assembly
scoped diff, schema and fingerprint checks
baseline_exception_evidence: Android diagnostics 2026-09-14 12:03:23-12:03:37 UTC: each parent request completed SWITCH_RETAINED preflight, then close_started changed to close_failed in 44-125 ms without any child/session/end or control/operation/acquire request.
The retained child stream stayed live: returning to the child produced orchestration.return_retained; audio and controller input continued while the Game overlay displayed Ready.

Source trace: same-game takeover calls beginRetainedActorHandoff(reuseRunningGame=true); a null providerProcessIdentityForTransfer throws before Gateway access, after beginRetainedGameSwitch has already called showOpaque and beginRetainedActorHandoff has closed the old transition coordinator.

device_topic_bindings.topic: Launch an allowed child game, return to the dashboard, select the parent and resume the same game; verify one retained stream, successful parent control and no previous-session-close error.
Exercise a deliberately rejected takeover and return to the child; verify the original stream is either revealed after a correlated frame or safely closed, never stuck on Ready with live audio/input.
Move ownership child to parent and back to an eligible child while keeping the same execution session; verify current actor control and child time attachment at each step.
